description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

As a Sales Engineer for our Enterprise Select business, you’ll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting sales in winning new business and expanding existing business, and (2) contributing to the SE Team on the quest of continually raising the bar. There is an expectation that an SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win business. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.

Additionally, an SE is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. 

This is a remote role, requiring travel up to 75%.

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

- You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 

- You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

- You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 

- You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

- Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara’s products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows.

- Facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers including hardware installation in and around vehicles and/or equipment ensuring prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.

- Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.

- Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.

- Be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches.

- Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base.

- Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement.

- Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels.

- Partner with account executives to plan, prepare, and execute strategic deals in complex sales cycles.

- Discover customer processes, needs and pain, translate that understanding to become a welcomed trusted advisor.

- Successfully match customer pain points and requirements to proposed solutions.

- Contribute to the team via technical and industry knowledge, training, etc.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles and 3+ years of pre-sales experience

- Experience with Enterprise sales cycles or equivalent

- Consistent track record selling complex solutions

- Clinical execution of discovery, through to POV, and technical win. 

- Understand and appreciate value selling, and MEDDICC.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Previous hands-on experience with customer evaluations and deployments

- Well-versed in one of the following: cloud software, IOT, networking, automation, and control systems

- Experience with integration projects. At minimum comprehend RESTFul APIs. A plus for scripting (Python, javascript, etc.) experience

- IoT, hardware gadgets, vehicles, or general tinkering experience (work or hobby) a plus

- Experience working with Fleet, Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, or general operations background a plus

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. title: Senior Security GRC Engineer
description:
Why Mozilla? 

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role: 

The role is part of the Security Function within the broader Mozilla Infrastructure team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise and GRC functions across the organization aligned with the mission to build a safe & secure internet. This role is responsible for defining, developing and helping implement a Governance, Risk and Compliance framework for both Enterprise and Product verticals. The ideal candidate will be responsible to deliver an integrated framework that aligns security, privacy, regulatory, and risk management initiatives across the organization. This is an ideal role for someone early in their GRC or security career who is curious, organized, and eager to take on a wide range of work. You’ll get broad exposure across risk, audit, and a growing set of security programs. 

What you'll do: 

Risk Management 

- Perform risk assessments and process incoming risk questions and intake requests 

- Maintain the risk register, keeping entries accurate, current, and well documented 

- Track risk treatment plans and follow up with owners on progress 

- Manage the exceptions and issues tracking process, including intake, documentation, expiration follow-up, and reporting 

- Support third-party risk activities, such as vendor assessments, questionnaire review, and tracking remediation 

Compliance and Audit 

- Coordinate evidence collection from control owners and chase outstanding requests 

- Help prepare control owners and stakeholders for audit interviews 

- Keep the SOC 2 system description, ISMS documentation, and Statement of Applicability (SoA) up to date 

- Track audit gaps and findings and drive remediation to closure with control owners 

Security Program Support 

- Help GRC and partner teams run governance for the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), including tracking adoption, gathering evidence, and maintaining supporting standards 

- Support data classification and data governance efforts by maintaining documentation, tracking adoption, and coordinating with data owners 

- Assist with business impact analysis (BIA) and business continuity/disaster recovery (BC/DR) activities, including plan maintenance, exercise coordination, and follow-up on gaps 

- Track vulnerability management metrics and remediation status, and follow up with system owners on overdue items 

- Help coordinate penetration testing engagements, from scoping and scheduling through findings tracking and remediation follow-up 

GRC Operations and Tooling 

- Serve as an administrator for our GRC platform, including users, workflows, integrations, and reporting 

- Identify opportunities to streamline processes and automate repetitive GRC work 

- Help maintain policies, standards, and supporting documentation 

What you'll bring: 

- Experience in cybersecurity, GRC, IT audit, or a related field (typically 2-4 years) 

- Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST 

- Familiarity with risk assessment concepts and the risk management lifecycle 

- Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to juggle many workstreams and deadlines at once 

- Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working with technical and non-technical stakeholders 

- A collaborative, curious mindset and a genuine desire to learn and take on new challenges 

- Hands-on experience with a GRC platform (e.g., Vanta, Drata, OneTrust, ServiceNow GRC, or similar) 

- Experience supporting an audit (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar) 

- Exposure to any of: vulnerability management, third-party risk, BC/DR, secure development practices, or penetration test coordination 

- Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, SQL, or workflow tools) to improve GRC processes 

- A relevant certification or one in progress (e.g., Security+, CISA, CISM, CISSP) 

What you'll get: 

- Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees—we share in our success as one team.

- Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage.

- Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute).

- Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together.

- Country-specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday.

- One-time home office stipend.

- Annual professional development budget.

- Quarterly well-being stipend.

- Considerable paid parental leave.

- Employee referral bonus program.

- Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc.—varies by country).

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientation s, gender identities, and expressions.

title: Staff QE, Mobile
description:
About AlphaSense : 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us.

About the Team: 

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role: 

Investors and analysts open our app between meetings, on a train, before a call, and act on what they see. Mobile releases go through app stores and cannot be rolled back, so a problem can stay in customers' hands for days.

Our mobile product is growing fast, with new AI workflows arriving on iPhone, iPad and Android at the pace of the rest of the platform. Our quality practice has real foundations, including Appium and native UI test suites and real-device runs, but our newest features are ahead of our automated coverage, and release confidence still depends too much on individual effort.

As Staff Quality Engineer, you own one question: can we ship mobile with confidence, every release, on all platforms? You decide what we test and what we deliberately leave out, and you turn what you build into a way of working that Mobile Engineering owns with you.

You will report to the head of Quality Engineering and work day to day with the iOS and Android teams, alongside backend, web and platform QE.

What Makes this a Staff role: 

- You set direction, not a task list. Nobody hands you a test plan. You look at the product, the release risk and the team, and decide what matters most and why.

- You own the outcome across platforms. Your scope is the quality of the product across clients, not one app or one team.

- You work through influence. You are an individual contributor. Your standards stick because engineers see their value, and success means they write more testable code, make better release calls and need you less over time.

What You’ll Do: 

- Define mobile quality strategy. Set the long-term strategy built on "Quality by Design" and "Automation by Default": test layers, device and OS matrix, and release criteria for iOS and Android.

- Set metrics the team can act on. Define quality metrics and coverage standards with Mobile Engineering and Product, so quality is measurable and sustainable without you.

- Turn release day into a clear call. With no instant rollback, own the quality gates, staged rollouts and evidence behind every go or no-go decision.

- Connect mobile to the rest of the platform. Mobile shares APIs and services with web, and customers update apps slowly, so changes elsewhere can break mobile after they have shipped. You are accountable for that risk.

- Make the test platform dependable. Keep real-device and CI runs stable and fast (Bitrise, BrowserStack, GitLab, Allure), including test data and enterprise (Intune/MDM) builds.

- Use AI where it earns its place. Use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot yourself, and help the team decide where they help and where human judgment must lead.

- Leave the team stronger. Coach engineers and QEs, review designs for testability, and leave behind standards other teams adopt.

What Success looks like: 

- First 90 days: You have audited current coverage, agreed a prioritized plan with Mobile Engineering and delivered your first measurable improvement.

- By 6 months: Critical mobile journeys are covered in the right layers on both platforms, and release readiness is an evidence-based call.

- By 12 months: Mobile quality is a practice the team owns, and other portfolios borrow your ideas.

Who You Are: 

- A quality engineer with 8+ years of experience, including 2+ at Staff or Lead level. You have connected quality strategy across web and mobile, not just worked on mobile alone, and set direction across several teams or apps as an individual contributor without people-management authority. You can show what changed because of it.

- Strong hands-on experience testing native mobile apps on at least one platform (iOS or Android), with working knowledge of the other. You are comfortable with real-device cloud and CI/CD for mobile builds, can work with tools such as XCUITest, Espresso, Compose UI testing or Appium, and code in at least one language such as Kotlin, Java, Swift or Python.

- Strong debugging skills across the mobile stack, from crash reports to network traces, and a good understanding of how mobile releases move through the app stores.

- Excellent test design and API testing, and comfortable in the backend: you can read APIs, debug across the client and service boundary, and work with contracts.

- Strong understanding of continuous delivery and release gating, with experience in test management systems such as Allure TestOps.

- An active AI tool user, with examples of where it helped and where it fell short.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Trusted by the U.S. Department of War and Fortune 500s, our platform runs on-premises and in private clouds, delivering secure messaging, file sharing, workflow automation, audio/screenshare, and project management—all with full data and operational control. Mattermost powers high-stakes workflows across mission planning, real-time, real-world operations, DevSecOps, incident response, and cyber defense—enabling secure collaboration from tactical edge and DDIL environments to enterprise HQ. To learn more, visit www.mattermost.com 

About Mattermost Federal 

Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Our platform runs on-premises, in private clouds and in air-gapped networks, and is trusted by defense, government and enterprise customers with strict security and compliance requirements.

About the Role 

We are looking for Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who want to solve real operational problems alongside mission teams. In this role you will work directly with operators, analysts, and engineers to deploy and build systems that are used every day in mission environments.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You will operate close to the mission, often inside classified environments, working through ambiguity and building solutions that have immediate operational impact.

The problems you will work on here are hard, ambiguous, and consequential.

What You'll Do 

- Work directly with defense and intelligence organizations to understand operational problems

- Deploy and integrate Mattermost in classified and mission-critical environments

- Build plugins, integrations, and automations that enable operational workflows

- Prototype new capabilities quickly and iterate based on operator feedback

- Debug complex systems operating in constrained environments

- Help shape the evolution of the Mattermost platform based on mission needs

You will move between writing code, deploying infrastructure, and working directly with operators, often within the same week. Travel is typically approximately one week per month onsite with customers.

What We're Looking For 

- Strong engineering ability (Go, Python, TypeScript, or similar)

- Comfort working across the full stack from infrastructure to applications

- Ability to solve open-ended technical problems

- Strong communication skills with both engineers and operators

- Willingness to travel approximately one week per month

Nice to Have 

- Experience working with DoD, IC, or national security organizations

- Experience deploying systems in secure or classified environments

- Familiarity with Kubernetes, distributed systems, and APIs

- Experience building integrations or operational tooling

AI-Forward Engineering 

Mattermost Federal is aggressively adopting AI-enabled workflows across mission operations. FDEs will be among the first engineers deploying and operationalizing AI capabilities in secure environments, including:

- AI agents that summarize operational channels and generate SITREPs

- AI-assisted mission timelines and decision logs

- Knowledge retrieval across operational history

- AI tools that help operators understand fast-moving mission data

Why This Role Exists 

The best software is built close to the problem. Forward Deployed Engineers at Mattermost Federal work directly with the people using the systems we build. You will see problems firsthand, build solutions quickly, and deploy them into environments where reliability, security, and speed matter.

Compensation 

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Actual compensation may vary based on location, skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions.

Mattermost offers a remote-first work environment with medical, dental, and vision coverage. You’ll also receive unlimited PTO plus company holidays, a work from home stipend, an annual learning and development budget for conferences, certifications, and courses, paid parental leave for all parents, and a 401(k) plan.

Canada Eligibility & Compliance 

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada without current or future sponsorship.

This role may require obtaining and maintaining a government security clearance or equivalent designation (such as Reliability Status or Secret clearance under Canada's Controlled Goods Program), depending on customer engagement. Candidates must meet eligibility requirements to be considered. 

Given Mattermost's work with U.S. defense and government customers, some positions may also require compliance with U.S. export control laws, including EAR and ITAR, which can apply to non-U.S. based employees working on covered technical data. For more information, visit the Bureau of Industry and Security and the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. 

Mattermost is an EEO Employer, we are a remote-first, open-source company.

We are continually working to expand our hiring in more countries and regions, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations, which takes time.

We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to assessing candidates based on their skills and qualifications. title: CAD scripting Expert
description:
Headquarters: 

Overview

We are building evaluation benchmarks that test whether AI agents can complete real professional work from start to finish. We are hiring expert mechanical design and CAD automation engineers to turn real, paid CAD tasks from their own work into expert-level Terminal-Bench challenges. Each task includes the files and systems it runs on, a working solution and a check that proves the result is correct.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

• Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks by turning real, paid mechanical CAD work from your own experience into challenges an AI agent must solve end to end.

• Define each task precisely, including the files, systems and environment it runs on, so an AI agent can attempt it without ambiguity or hidden assumptions.

• Write a working reference solution using scripted CAD, such as FreeCAD or CadQuery Python, that rebuilds parametric parts correctly after parameters change.

• Build automated checks and tests that prove the result is objectively correct, covering geometry, dimensions, tolerances and file outputs such as STEP or IGES.

• Calibrate difficulty so each task takes an expert about 60-75 minutes to solve, and explain how a real-world mistake would be caught by the checks.

• Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback, documenting the design intent, tools, data and rules used so others can reproduce and validate your work.

Skills/Experience

• 3+ years designing real mechanical parts that were manufactured or shipped, doing the hands-on work yourself (not only studying, selling, managing or teaching it)

• Hands-on CAD work within the last 3 years, with the ability to name the systems, tools, data and rules you used

• Builds or modifies designs through scripts (FreeCAD or CadQuery Python, OpenSCAD, Onshape FeatureScript), not only through GUI work

• Reads engineering drawings, tolerances and GD&T, and can explain how a design mistake would be caught

• Technical fluency with Python or another language and the command line, plus files such as CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

• Availability to start around early November 2026 and take on tasks on a flexible, task-based schedule

Nice-to-have

• Parametric design-intent experience

• Open-source hardware contributions or projects

• Docker and Git experience

• Experience writing automated tests

• Experience with SolidWorks, Fusion or Onshape APIs and STEP/IGES workflows

Process

• Task-based vetting: you complete a vetting task instead of an interview

• Paid per task, with each task taking about 60-75 minutes to solve

• Flexible, task-based work cadence, with an expected start around early November 2026

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-cad-scripting-expert

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Document Intelligence
description:
Headquarters: New Jersey, USA

URL: https://vertican.com 

About the role

For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.

We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.

We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.

You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.

What you will do

Design the pipelines. Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.

We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.

Evaluate new systems before we adopt them. Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.

Build the evaluation process. You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline. 

Ship and operate. Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.

Set direction. Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.

What we are looking for

Required 

- 6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.

- Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.

- Ideally hands-on experience with document understanding: OCR or layout models, field extraction from scanned PDFs, or intelligent document processing products.

- Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale (Splink, Dedupe, Zingg, or your own blocking-and-scoring system) against databases of hundreds of thousands of rows.

- You have designed an evaluation from scratch: built a labeled ground-truth set, chosen the metrics, and defended a threshold to a non-technical stakeholder.

- Production experience with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling and cost or rate-limit management; you can say when an LLM is the wrong tool.

- Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable reading Postgres query plans and writing the raw query when the ORM gets in the way.

- Engineering/Scientist mindset: you are scientific about testing the pipeline and how results are interpeted/presented.

Nice to have 

- Azure AI services (Content Understanding, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, Foundry) or the AWS and GCP equivalents.

- Financial document processing: checks, remittance advices, lockbox files, payment matching, or accounts receivable automation.

- Exposure to collections, legal operations or other regulated workflows handling PII.

- Probabilistic matching theory (Fellegi-Sunter) or active-learning labeling workflows.

- Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.

How we work and what we offer

Small team, direct access to large datasets, weekly planning, daily standup, everyone remote in US timezones.

What we offer:

- A small team of tight-knit, like-minded people passionate about high quality software

- Competitive compensation, commensurate with a senior individual-contributor role.

- Monthly payments in USD

Vertican is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vertican-senior-applied-ai-engineer-document-intelligence

L'Agence de services et de paiement (ASP) est un établissement public administratif sous la double tutelle des ministères en charge de l’Agriculture et de l'Emploi. La programmation des Fonds européens 2028-2034 instaure une approche intégrée regroupant l'ensemble des fonds européens au sein d'un Plan de Partenariat National-Régional (PPNR), afin de simplifier leur pilotage. Cette réforme s'accompagne d'une évolution des systèmes d'information nécessaires aux échanges avec la Commission européenne. title: Software Engineer III | Framework
description:
At ExtraHop , we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. 

Position Summary 

As a Software Engineer III, you will drive key architectural and technical decisions, lead the design and execution of complex engineering initiatives, and elevate technical standards across the Framework team. You’ll partner closely with principal engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure systems that power core ExtraHop products. This role is designed for an experienced engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong ownership and is motivated to grow their impact through excellent engineering and active collaboration.

Our team builds high-performance network detection and monitoring systems that operate at scale across increasingly complex protocols and data volumes.Our services and features are written primarily in C and C++ with a focus on security, scalability, stability, and reliability. Our team is focussed on enhancing, maintaining and optimizing core components of the system and functional areas related to protocol parsing, metrics publishing, continuous packet capture and Time Series DB. 

This role focuses on designing and optimizing these core systems with an emphasis on performance, reliability and deep protocol awareness. You will work on next generation initiatives including scaling and performance improvement efforts, evolution of our data storage architecture (custom to open-source based) and early steps towards a cloud enabled model. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services for ExtraHop's core Framework systems, taking ownership of moderately complex to complex features with limited guidance.

- Work across networking layers to implement and enhance protocol support

- Participate actively in technical design discussions, contribute to architecture decisions within your team, and author clear technical documentation for your work.

- Engage fully in agile development processes, including sprint planning, code reviews, and retrospectives; hold a high bar for code quality and test coverage.

- Collaborate with Product and cross-functional engineering partners such as platform , infrastructure and cloud teams to to define technical roadmaps, break down ambiguous problems, and balance technical debt with delivery.

- Investigate, diagnose, and resolve production and performance issues independently; conduct root-cause analysis and implement preventive measures.

- Contribute to platform modernization efforts and help evaluate and adopt new technologies or frameworks in partnership with senior and principal engineers.

- Participate in on-call rotations and improve system observability, reliability and operational readiness. 

Required Qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in STEM field, Computer Science, Engineering, or related degree requiring systematic/analytical thinking

- 4+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems at scale

- Strong expertise in C and C++ 

- Experience developing on Linux Systems (multi threading, memory management, IPC etc)

- Proven ability to build and maintain performance critical systems. 

- Proven ability to debug complex issues (eg. using gdb, coredumps, performance tools)

- Strong understanding of networking fundamentals 

- Strong command of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles, with the ability to decompose complex problems into clear, actionable engineering tasks.

- Self-starter who can operate independently, manage competing priorities, and drive work to completion with minimal oversight.

- Excellent collaborator and communicator with a growth mindset and customer-first orientation.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications 

- Experience with network protocols (eg. HTTP, SMB, Kerberos, TLS, Microsoft protocols or similar)

- Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred) or distributed systems

- Experience with observability, on-call practices and production systems

- Scripting experience (Python or similar)

Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $163,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more. 

ABOUT EXTRAHOP 

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES 

Our culture is rooted in our five Values . These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team. 

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. 

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team. 

BENEFITS 

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

- Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits

- Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time

- Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan

- FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable

- Educational Reimbursement

- 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable

- Pet Insurance (US Only)

- Parental Leave (US Only)

- Hybrid and Remote Work Model

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn .

A fast-growing AI evaluation company is building expert-level benchmarks that test how well AI agents handle real professional work in the terminal. title: Principal AI & Automation Lead
description:
AI speelt een steeds grotere rol in hoe we onze producten verbeteren, klanten ondersteunen en interne processen slimmer inrichten. Maar de échte waarde van AI zit wat ons betreft niet in de technologie zelf, maar in wat we ermee kunnen bereiken.

Als onze AI & Automation Lead ontdek je waar AI het verschil kan maken. Je gaat met collega's uit verschillende afdelingen in gesprek, luistert naar hun ervaringen en uitdagingen en vertaalt ideeën en behoeften naar praktische oplossingen.

Dat doe je niet alleen achter je eigen scherm. Je organiseert workshops, helpt collega's met verschillende niveaus van technische kennis op weg met AI, experimenteert met nieuwe technologie en bouwt zelf prototypes en automatiseringen.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om kansen te ontdekken, prioriteiten te stellen en initiatieven van idee tot implementatie te begeleiden. Daarmee maak je niet alleen het werk van je collega's makkelijker en leuker, maar draag je ook bij aan betere producten en dienstverlening voor onze 270.000 klanten.

Wie zijn wij?

Mijndomein is een van de grootste en laatste onafhankelijke hostingproviders van Nederland. Omdat we volledig in privébezit zijn, groeien we op onze eigen manier: wendbaar, klantgericht en met een langetermijnvisie.

We nemen beslissingen met het belang van onze klanten én het bedrijf voor ogen. Inmiddels vertrouwen 270.000 klanten op onze diensten en beheren we meer dan 1 miljoen domeinnamen.

En omdat we geloven in samen bouwen, kunnen medewerkers via onze participatieregeling mede-eigenaar worden van de organisatie en zo meedelen in de waarde die we samen creëren.

Mijndomein is onderdeel van The Sharing Group, actief binnen Online, Mobiliteit en Energie

Wat ga je doen?

Als AI & Automation Lead speel je een belangrijke rol bij het inzetten van AI binnen Mijndomein. Je houdt je bezig met interne bedrijfsprocessen én toepassingen die onze producten en dienstverlening verbeteren.

Concreet betekent dit dat je: 

- Kansen ontdekt en prioriteiten stelt: je brengt ons huidige AI-gebruik in kaart, ontdekt verbeterkansen en bepaalt samen met collega's welke initiatieven de meeste waarde opleveren.

- Processen automatiseert: je ontwikkelt praktische automatiseringen en AI-workflows die repetitief werk verminderen en collega's tijd besparen.

- Collega's verder helpt: je organiseert toegankelijke trainingen en workshops, ondersteunt collega's bij het gebruik van AI en deelt succesvolle toepassingen tussen afdelingen.

- Ideeën tot leven brengt: je bouwt prototypes en pilots om nieuwe toepassingen te testen. Voor grotere of complexere oplossingen werk je samen met onze developers.

- Tools beoordeelt: je onderzoekt bestaande en nieuwe AI-tools en adviseert over hun toegevoegde waarde, bruikbaarheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid en mogelijke risico's.

- Resultaten zichtbaar maakt: je onderzoekt wat toepassingen daadwerkelijk opleveren, bijvoorbeeld in tijdsbesparing, kwaliteit of klanttevredenheid.

- Vooruitkijkt: je volgt relevante AI-ontwikkelingen en helpt op basis van nieuwe inzichten onze AI-strategie verder vorm te geven.

Daarbij draait het niet om zoveel mogelijk AI-tools introduceren, maar om oplossingen die daadwerkelijk iets toevoegen. Niet ieder probleem heeft AI nodig en niet ieder experiment hoeft een succes te worden. We vinden het belangrijk om samen te leren van wat wel én niet werkt.

We zoeken iemand die enthousiast wordt van nieuwe technologie, maar nog veel enthousiaster van wat je ermee kunt oplossen.

Je hebt ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van AI-projecten van idee tot implementatie. Je bent technisch onderlegd, bouwt graag zelf oplossingen en weet wanneer het waardevol is om de kennis en expertise van anderen te betrekken.

Je kunt omgaan met een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Je neemt initiatief, brengt structuur aan en helpt collega's om nieuwe technologie te begrijpen en te benutten, op een manier die aansluit bij hun kennis en behoeften.

Hoe je jouw kennis en ervaring hebt opgedaan, vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je ermee kunt bereiken. Of je nu een technische opleiding hebt gevolgd, jezelf veel hebt aangeleerd of vanuit een ander vakgebied in AI en automatisering bent terechtgekomen: we zijn benieuwd naar wat jij meebrengt.

Wat breng je mee? 

- Ervaring met het implementeren van AI-oplossingen, automatiseringen of vergelijkbare technologische verbeteringen binnen organisaties.

- De technische kennis om zelfstandig prototypes, AI-workflows en automatiseringen te ontwikkelen.

- Kennis van API's, integraties en moderne AI-tools, en inzicht in hoe je verschillende systemen met elkaar kunt laten samenwerken.

- Het vermogen om zelfstandig projecten te begeleiden, prioriteiten te stellen en onderscheid te maken tussen interessante experimenten en waardevolle oplossingen.

- Het vermogen om technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen en collega's te ondersteunen bij veranderingen.

- Oog voor privacy, informatiebeveiliging en verantwoord gebruik van AI, waaronder mogelijke vooroordelen en risico's van AI-toepassingen.

- Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van toepassingen rondom LLM's, AI-agents of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

- Een nieuwsgierige, praktische en resultaatgerichte aanpak, waarbij je openstaat voor feedback en verschillende perspectieven.

Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste: 

- Ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python of JavaScript.

- Ervaring met automatiseringsplatformen zoals n8n, Make of vergelijkbare tools.

- Ervaring met het organiseren van workshops, trainingen of interne kennissessies.

- Affiniteit met hosting, SaaS of andere technische dienstverlening.

Herken je jezelf in deze rol, maar voldoe je niet aan alle punten? Laat je daardoor niet tegenhouden om te solliciteren. We kijken graag naar jouw kennis, ervaring, potentieel en motivatie.

Wat bieden wij?

Stick Together, Own It & Be Bold. Dat zijn onze kernwaarden en die zie je terug in hoe we samenwerken.

Bij Mijndomein krijg je de vrijheid om ideeën niet alleen aan te dragen, maar ook daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. We helpen elkaar, geven ruimte aan verschillende perspectieven en waarderen initiatief, constructieve feedback en de bereidheid om te experimenteren en te leren.

We geloven dat verschillende achtergronden, ervaringen en manieren van denken ons als organisatie sterker maken. We vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, zich gehoord voelt en de ruimte krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen.

We zijn goed ingericht op hybride werken, maar vinden het ook belangrijk om elkaar regelmatig te ontmoeten. Daarom werk je minimaal twee dagen per week op ons kantoor in Almere, op dinsdag en donderdag . Regelmatig komt daar ook de maandag bij, waardoor je vaak drie dagen per week op kantoor bent.

Daarnaast bieden we: 

- Een passend salaris, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

title: Robotics Systems Engineer (Mechanical)
description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for an experienced Robotics Systems Engineer (Mechanical) to join our team of product developers and robot enthusiasts. We build competitive products for our customers, and they depend on tightly integrated, complex mechatronic systems. In this role, you bridge mechanical design and system-level engineering. You own how mechanical subsystems fit into the overall robot architecture, from requirements and interfaces through integration, verification, and field support.

You will work closely with specialists from R&D, electronics, and software development to define, evaluate, integrate, and validate the robotic system across the full product development process. You will also work continuously with our operations team so that system decisions meet product target costs, manufacturability, and quality standards as ONE TEAM. Your work makes our robots more nimble, robust, and user-friendly, and opens new ways to optimize system performance and capabilities. We are passionate about excellent hardware design and system performance at competitive costs.

The Impact 

As a Robotics Systems Engineer (Mechanical) , you will play a crucial role in shaping the architecture and design of our future robotic systems. You will turn customer and product needs into system and mechanical requirements, define and manage subsystem interfaces, and drive trade-off decisions on performance, robustness, weight, cost, and serviceability. Your contributions will directly increase the reliability and attractiveness of our products.

With your innovative mindset and industrial experience, you will bring new ideas and methods to how we develop, integrate, and verify our robots. Your hands-on experience with mechatronic systems makes you key to improving and upgrading the robot’s functions. Working alongside our R&D experts, you will strengthen our ability to sustain and continuously improve our product portfolio in the field.

Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sectors by bringing robotics to a wide range of new applications that were previously out of reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LiDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality, consistent inspection results. We develop a wide range of custom hardware in-house, including the complete robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related mechanical hardware, and integrate it into one reliable system.

Your Contributions 

- Define system and mechanical requirements from customer needs and use cases

- Shape the system architecture and design integrated mechatronic subsystems

- Define and manage interfaces between platform, actuators, sensors, payloads, and charging systems

- Drive trade-offs on performance, robustness, weight, cost, and serviceability

- Plan and run system integration, verification, and validation

- Do engineering analyses, including FEA and tolerance stack-ups

- Monitor robustness, cost, and quality across the product life cycle, including root cause analyses and field inspections

- Work with R&D, software, and operations on specifications and design reviews

- Create system and product documentation, from specifications to assembly and user manuals

Your Profile 

- University degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, or a related field

- At least 5 years of industrial experience in systems engineering or mechanical product development

- Proven experience with requirements engineering, interface management, and system integration of mechatronic products

- Hands-on experience with verification, validation, and testing

- Proficient in SolidWorks and PDM environments

- Experience with FEA, tolerance analysis, and DIN/ISO tolerancing standards

- Knowledge of design-to-cost and productivity optimization methods

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Structured team player who enjoys working across disciplines in a high-tech company

Bonus Points 

- Experience with MBSE or requirements management tools is a plus

- Experience sizing standard components such as motors, gearboxes, and bearings

- Experience with explosion-proof design and certification under ATEX and IECEx

- Knowledge of the design and manufacturing of injection-molded parts

- Experience with electric drives and control theory

- Programming skills (e.g. Python) for analysis, testing, or automation

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

About the role 

We're looking for a RevOps Systems Architect to help build a modern, AI-powered revenue operations stack. This isn't a traditional Salesforce admin role. We're building a GTM tech stack where AI is a first-class citizen, automations are genuinely intelligent, and our CRM is a living system that reflects how our business actually works.

You'll function as a Salesforce admin and backend developer in one. You'll own platform administration, build complex automations via Flows and Apex, and develop and maintain custom services and integrations, including Salesforce MCP servers and AI tooling that connect our CRM to the broader systems our team runs on. -

Translate ambiguous business problems into clean technical scope, from stakeholder conversation to implemented solution.

- 
Strong Apex development skills: you can build, debug, and maintain custom logic, triggers, and integrations without leaning on a separate engineering team.

-

Excited by modern tooling: you're drawn to building AI-native systems and are curious about where Salesforce, MCP, and AI agents intersect.

Bonus:

Experience with BI tools such as Sigma or Looker.

title: Applied Machine Learning Engineer, EMEA
description:
About Us: 

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role: 

As an Applied Machine Learning Engineer, you are the technical owner of a customer engagement. This is what is globally known as the Forward Deployed Engineer role; at Fireworks in EMEA it carries the AMLE title. You embed with a small number of accounts, work in their environment, and own whatever stands between them and production on Fireworks: the model, the serving path, the integration, the performance. You scope the work before signature and deliver what you scoped. Depth over breadth: few accounts, owned end to end.

What we value most is first principles thinking: reasoning about unfamiliar problems from the ground up rather than from playbooks. You will be evaluated on this directly in the interview process, and strength here can outweigh gaps elsewhere in your background.

Four Spikes: 

- Software engineering. You ship production systems and are comfortable dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or a customer environment with a deadline. Backend and systems depth, strong Python plus at least one systems language, and fluency with AI-assisted and agentic engineering as a core part of how you build.

- Machine learning. You take open models and make them better on a customer's task: SFT, LoRA and other parameter-efficient methods, reinforcement learning (RLHF, RLVR), distillation. Just as important, you design evaluations that reflect the real task and let them drive training decisions, and you know when fine-tuning is not the answer.

- Infrastructure and performance. You know your GPUs: memory bandwidth, kernels, parallelism, what utilization numbers actually mean. Serving and inference optimization: quantization, speculative decoding, batching, KV cache behavior, latency vs throughput tradeoffs, multi-GPU and multi-node serving, capacity planning. You can take a deployment that works and make it fast and economical, and reason about where the bottleneck is before touching a profiler.

- Customer engagement. You want to be in the room. The point of this role is creating specialized intelligence for each customer: the best model for their task, their data, their constraints. That takes real interest in the customer's problem, not just the technical one. Exceptional here looks like founder energy with customers; the floor is genuine appetite to embed, explain, and own outcomes with them.

Key Responsibilities: 

- Own Engagements: Take customer deployments from scoping through production, as the single accountable technical owner.

- Embed: Work directly inside customer teams; understand their domain, data, and constraints well enough to make decisions they trust.

- Train and Tune: Run fine-tuning and post-training work where the engagement needs it, from data to evaluation to a model serving in production.

- Optimize: Drive serving performance and cost on Fireworks: model choice, deployment shape, and inference optimization.

- Scope Honestly: Assess what is achievable before we commit, and inherit what you scope.

- Product Signal: Feed what customers need back to product and engineering, with enough precision to be actionable.

Minimum Qualifications: 

- Spikes in two or all three areas.

- For the ML spike: formal training (PhD, PhD in progress, or a strong MSc) and experience post-training LLMs specifically.

- For the infrastructure spike: experience with GPU infrastructure, distributed serving, or inference engines.

- Founder or founding engineer experience.

- Experience in a startup or fast-paced environment.

Why Fireworks? 

- Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

- Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

- Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

- Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

title: Machine Learning Researcher
description:
About the Position

Our goals are to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street as a Machine Learning Researcher while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. You'll work side by side with experienced ML Researchers on projects that we've selected for their combination of novel ML ideas and relevance to real-world systematic trading strategies. You'll learn how we think about markets through challenging classes and activities, and practice using established methods alongside our own unique twists to train practical models.

At Jane Street, the lines between research, technology, and trading are intentionally blurry, and you’ll have access to petabytes of data, a computing cluster with hundreds of thousands of cores, and a growing GPU cluster containing tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges—large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment—that force us to search for novel techniques.

You'll spend the bulk of your internship working closely with full-time machine learning researchers on projects drawn from their own work. You might conduct an end-to-end study of an unexplored dataset, try a new modelling paradigm for a thorny problem, or consider blue-sky approaches that we're still trying to figure out. The problems we work on rarely have clean, definitive answers, and they often require insights from colleagues across the firm with different areas of expertise. Depending on the day, you might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging training issues, or analysing the predictions your model makes.

Note that given the IP-sensitive nature of machine learning research at Jane Street, it is unlikely that any research findings associated with the internship will be suitable for outside academic publication.

About you

If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

- An undergraduate, PhD student, or postdoc with practical experience working on ML problems

- Interested in applying logical and mathematical thinking to all kinds of problems

- Curious about the machine learning landscape and excited to apply state-of-the-art techniques drawn from many problem domains

- Fluent with a versatile set of models and tricks

- Able to rapidly implement and iterate on your ideas in Python and your favourite ML framework

- Eager to ask questions, admit mistakes, and learn new things

- Fluent in English

If you'd like to learn more, you can read about our interview process and meet some of the team . Learn more about Jane Street's internship program here .

About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. 

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

This role sits on the Verticals team within Life360 — the group building the next frontier of meaningful connection beyond the core family circle. This role's initial focus is Aging in Place: helping aging parents stay safely independent while giving the families around them real peace of mind. Over time, this role may flex to support other emerging verticals — Things (Tile, connected trackers) or Pets — as priorities shift, so we're looking for someone who wants to help define the pattern for new member segments, not just ship one feature set.

We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. That means AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We've redesigned our team workflows around AI, treating it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale.

About the Job

Life360 is hiring an AI Native Senior Software Engineer — a senior engineer who doesn't just use AI tools, but thinks natively in them. You'll be central to how the Verticals team builds products.

You'll design and build features that serve one of our most important and fastest-growing member segments: aging parents who want to stay safely connected with, and independent from, the families who care about them. As priorities change, you may also apply these same patterns to Things (connected trackers) or Pets.

You will take full ownership of what you build from the first line of code through production, on-call, and the member impact it has. You obsess over the humans on the other end of the product, not just the ticket.

Full-stack experience is required for this role — you should be comfortable moving between backend services and the mobile surfaces that expose them. Our stack spans Spring Boot microservices, Java, Kafka, and Kafka Streams on the backend, a modern cloud-native platform on AWS, and native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps on the client side.

In your first year, success looks like having shipped end-to-end features serving the Aging in Place member segment and establishing at least one AI-native workflow the broader team adopts.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $103,500 to $192,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 149,500 to 177,500 CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. 

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) , as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

- Ship end-to-end across the stack — from backend services and APIs through to the iOS and Android surfaces members use, serving tens of millions of users — moving between layers as the feature demands.

- Work with AI (Claude Code) as a first-class collaborator — orchestrate agents to create specs, generate code, and perform reviews, moving faster without sacrificing quality.

- Define and codify AI-Native engineering practices for the Verticals team, establishing playbooks the broader org can adopt.

- Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to turn complex user problems into scalable engineering solutions.

- Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and a culture of craft and continuous improvement.

- Participate in on-call rotation and incident response.

- Mentor team members and contribute to team processes and technical standards.

- Support performance, reliability, and accessibility across the features you own.

- Adapt patterns and services built for Aging in Place to future verticals (Things, Pets) as team scope expands.

What We’re Looking For

AI-Native Expectations

We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice:

title: Compiler Engineer - Machine Learning Compiler
description:
About us 

Mythic is building the future of AI computing with breakthrough analog technology that delivers 100× the performance of traditional digital systems at the same power and cost. This unlocks bigger, more capable models and faster, more responsive applications—whether in edge devices like drones, robotics, and sensors, or in cloud and data center environments. Our technology powers everything from large language models and CNNs to advanced signal processing, and is engineered to operate from –40 °C to +125 °C, making it ideal for industrial, automotive, aerospace, and defense.

We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Softbank, Threshold Ventures, Lux Capital, and DCVC, and secured multi-million-dollar customer contracts across multiple markets.

About the role 

Join us in building the next generation of AI compilers. You’ll play a key role in developing the compiler for our novel AI accelerator, working side-by-side with hardware engineers and ML researchers. Your work will shape how deep learning workloads run on cutting-edge dataflow hardware—defining the instruction set, execution model, and developer experience. The result: a compiler that delivers breakthrough performance while remaining seamless and intuitive for ML developers.

Here's what you will do

- Contribute across the full compiler stack, including operator lowering, graph/IR transformations, optimization passes, and backend code generation

- Optimize for dataflow architectures, developing pipelined schedules, memory orchestration, and resource-constrained execution strategies

- Collaborate with hardware architects to influence architectural features, ensuring the compiler and hardware evolve together

- Develop compilation strategies that unify our analog compute with digital subsystems

- Build and maintain a compiler that produces high-performance binaries with strong debugging support, clear error messages, and predictable performance models

Here's the background we hope you will have

- 3+ years of experience building compilers or high-performance systems software, especially those involving complex resource management or optimization. 

- Expert in modern C++ (C++14/17/20) and strong Python.

- Experience with compiler IRs (SSA-based or graph-based), transformations, and code generation

- Exposure to specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) or parallel architectures

The following would be nice to have, but is not required

- Experience with machine learning compiler stacks (e.g., ONNX, MLIR, TVM, XLA, IREE, PyTorch), with contributions to MLIR or LLVM projects a plus

- Experience with optimization methods (LP/MIP, CP, SAT/SMT) using solvers like Gurobi or OR-Tools for scheduling and resource allocation

- Experience compiling for specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) on DNN workloads; GPU/DSP experience is valuable if combined with compiler backend work beyond kernel tuning

- Familiarity with heterogeneous compilation, especially mixing custom accelerators with CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, and exposure to analog or in-memory compute is a plus

- Experience collaborating in compiler–hardware co-design (architecture + ISA) for better compiler usability and hardware efficiency

What we offer

- The opportunity to shape how deep learning and LLM workloads are compiled on novel hardware.

- A role that spans software and hardware co-design, shaping both the compiler and the accelerator architecture

- A collaborative, innovative team that values engineering rigor, continuous integration, and user-focused design. We foster an environment of shared learning and technical excellence

- Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package

Compensation

Additional Information

At Mythic, we foster a collaborative and respectful environment where people can do their best work. We hire smart, capable individuals, provide the tools and support they need, and trust them to deliver. Our team brings a wide range of experiences and perspectives, which we see as a strength in solving hard problems together. We value professionalism, creativity, and integrity, and strive to make Mythic a place where every employee feels they belong and can contribute meaningfully.
