title: Senior Backend Software Engineer | Identity Foundations
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. 

GET TO KNOW US 

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! 

THE OPPORTUNITY 

We are hiring a Senior Backend Software Engineer to our Identity Foundations (IDF) team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

We’re looking for an autonomous and resourceful engineer to join our international Identity Foundations (IDF) team, which owns critical services at the heart of our product—including our login engine, session management, and single sign-on (SSO). You’ll build features that sit at the spine of the platform, powering experiences used by millions of users while tackling complex engineering challenges around performance, reliability, and multi-region scalability. You’ll also play a key role in driving our AI transformation, leveraging AI-assisted development to raise engineering standards, accelerate delivery, and build seamless, reliable identity foundations.

YOUR IMPACT 

- Own end-to-end projects from technical design through implementation, rollout, and production operation—impacting critical red-route authentication workflows for users, clients, and partners through heavy testing, organization, and strategic execution.

- Build and evolve maintainable, reliable, and scalable backend services that operate at massive scale across different regions, continuously identifying ways to improve production systems.

- Drive our AI transformation by leveraging LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to raise engineering standards, accelerate delivery, and elevate problem-solving workflows.

- Author technical documentation, such as RFCs, to articulate architectural ideas, share knowledge, and actively engage in reviewing peers' proposals.

- Deliver committed initiatives across tactical cycles to help the company achieve its core strategic goals.

- Champion a "you build it, you run it" engineering culture by monitoring rollouts, guaranteeing quality through comprehensive testing, and responding effectively to bugs and production incidents.

- Collaborate within an agile, people-first environment by exchanging constructive feedback on growth, successes, and mistakes to help your team develop professionally and foster a great place to work.

- Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE 

- An experienced backend engineer with years of experience building and operating production backend systems, with expertise in Kotlin/Spring and/or Golang highly desirable.

- A distributed systems specialist with strong experience designing and scaling APIs, data-intensive applications, cloud-native architectures on platforms like AWS, and scalable databases such as PostgreSQL.

- A cloud-native practitioner with hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and operating services in production using Kubernetes or similar container orchestration platforms, alongside Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision components like databases, caches, lambdas, and CDN configurations.

- An infrastructure and reliability-minded builder experienced in asynchronous processing using message brokers (such as Kafka, SQS/SNS, or RabbitMQ) and production observability tools (such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus).

- An AI-fluent technologist who thoughtfully leverages modern LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to enhance engineering workflows and solve complex technical problems.

- An autonomous, end-to-end owner who makes thoughtful technical decisions, embraces a "you build it, you run it" mindset, and independently drives projects from design to production operation.

- A clear and confident communicator who thrives in collaborative, agile environments that prioritize people over process—comfortable influencing technical decisions, sharing ideas across teams, and giving and receiving constructive feedback.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Kotlin/Spring and/or Golang are mandatory requirements. 

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. 

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include: 

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content. 

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance. 

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office. 

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. 

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube ! 

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub 

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. 

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here. 

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

title: Senior Research Scientist 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI
description:
Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core. 

Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics. 

Role

As a Senior 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI Engineer, you will own the development of the geometric and semantic perception stacks that power our physical AI framework. You will design real-time systems that enable our robots to translate unstructured, dynamic 3D environments into structured, queryable world models - seamlessly linking high-level task planners (such as VLM/VLA models) directly to robust, low-level manipulation and grasp policies in Flowstate. 

How your work moves the mission forward

- Design and deploy real-time spatial perception and state estimation pipelines using both in-house models like Gemini/Gemma and open source models

- Build multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating RGB-D, stereo cameras, and IMU data into dense spatial representations (ex: point clouds, neural occupancy grids, or implicit signed distance function fields)

- Ground high-level semantic concepts into 3D geometric structures. This means building queryable, object-centric 3D scene graphs that map not just where an object is, but what it is, and its relationship to the other objects, and its functional properties

- Integrate open-vocabulary vision language models (ex: CLiP based visual descriptors, DINOv2) into 3D metric space to allow the robot to reason about natural language instructions (ex: ‘pick up the half-eaten apple and put it in the trash bin’)

- Develop learning-based spatial models (such as 3D Diffusion Policies) that utilize 3D point clouds to predict continuous grasp poses and trajectories

- Translate abstract semantic logic into functional affordances (ex: identifying the ‘graspable’ part of a mug versus the ‘containment’ part)

- Collaborate with eng teams to ensure that stochastic, learned semantic models cleanly map to deterministic safe boundaries on physical hardware

- Drive data strategies for collecting, labeling, and generating 3D synthetic data 

Skills you will need to be successful

- Education: PhD (preferred) or Master’s in Robotics, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field—with a focus on Spatial AI, SLAM, or Embodied AI .

- 3D Vision: Deep mathematical foundations in multi-view geometry, camera calibration, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), and probabilistic state estimation .

- Modern Deep Learning: Proven experience training and deploying multimodal architectures (VLMs/VLAs), contrastive learning frameworks, or 3D neural scene representations (NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting)

- Programming & Systems : Expert level command of Python (PyTorch)

Skills that will differentiate your candidacy

- Experience with robotics middleware (ROS2) and real time execution constraints would be a plus

- Hands-on "battle scars" from deploying onto physical robotic manipulators or mobile platforms

Semiconductor manufacturers can't build what they can't measure. Invisix Measuring Systems is a fast-growing scale-up in the high-tech industry, developing next-generation metrology solutions for the semiconductor sector. We work at the intersection of optics, software, and data.

We're a small team, but the depth of knowledge inside Invisix is anything but small. Our culture is professional and fast-paced, with short communication lines and a strong sense of shared purpose. Everyone here is committed, and everyone knows their work directly contributes to something bigger.

The Role 

We're looking for a System Engineer to make our metrology equipment work to spec in a real program: requirements, error budgets, integration and verification, and system-level problem solving amongst others.

Reporting to our CTO, you take a program or release of our product, or a subsystem of it, from requirements to a tool that passes customer acceptance and ships on time. You work with our module and discipline engineers, integration, quality and service, and you're the technical contact for customers on specifications, acceptance criteria and escalations. Our system architect owns the concept; you make it work and prove it. The role includes occasional travel to customers in Asia, the US and Europe.

Key Responsibilities 

- Break down system requirements into module requirements, and keep them traceable from customer need to test result

- Own the detailed error budgets, and update them with measured data as the system matures

- Write and maintain the interface control documents between modules, together with the module and discipline engineers

- Set up integration, test, verification and qualification plans, and make sure the tool passes customer acceptance

- Find the root cause of system-level problems across disciplines, and stay in contact with the factory and the field after shipment

- Agree specifications and acceptance criteria with the system architect, handle technical escalations, and take on adjacent responsibilities as the company grows, such as system engineering for a next product release

Is this you? 

- MSc or PhD in physics, applied physics, mechatronics, electrical engineering or a related field, with at least 5 years of experience in system engineering for complex high-tech equipment

- Experience in semiconductor equipment, for example lithography, metrology or inspection, or in comparable high-tech equipment

- A solid physics background, especially in optics or measurement physics, so you can understand and quantify what limits system performance

- Hands-on experience with requirements breakdown and traceability, error budgets, and integration, verification and qualification plans

- Experience with model-based systems engineering (MBSE), for example with SysML

- A rigorous, data-driven and systematic way of working, and enough depth in several disciplines to debug across them

- Active use of AI tooling in your daily work (requirements analysis, data analysis, test reporting, documentation) to boost efficiency

Nice to have 

- Experience with customer acceptance and field escalations at semiconductor manufacturers

- Experience with requirements management tools, such as Polarion or DOORS

- Experience with statistical data analysis, for example in Python or MATLAB

- Experience in a startup or scale-up

What We Offer 

- A role at the heart of our programs, taking our metrology equipment from requirements to customer acceptance, with real ownership from day one

- Competitive salary and benefits, including an Employee Share Ownership Plan

- A learning and development budget to support your growth

- Flexible working arrangements, and room to grow into adjacent responsibilities as the team scales

Why Mozilla? 

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team: 

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role: 

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will lean on your Windows expertise, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’re a clear communicator and expert in your domain, ready to work on multi-month projects. You’ll contribute to the team through code review, mentoring, and discussion. 

What you’ll do: 

- Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users. 

- Lead projects that improve the stability, security, and performance of Firefox. 

- Collaborate with experienced software engineers.

- Work with a geographically-distributed development team. 

- Interact with teams throughout the organization.

title: Staff Design Verification Engineer, AI HW
description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Our Tensix team is building custom AI compute cores, RISC-V CPUs, and chiplet-based architectures for datacenter, edge, and automotive AI. Design Verification Engineers on this team validate compute IP and subsystems and build scalable DV infrastructure to keep verification fast, automated, and production-grade.

This role is hybrid, based out of Toronto, ON, Austin, TX or Belgrade, Serbia.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are 

- Experienced in modern verification methodologies with strong SystemVerilog skills and exposure to structured testbench development.

- Comfortable working from block-level to system-level verification and reasoning about microarchitecture behavior from specs and waveforms.

- Proficient in Linux environments with Python, or Bash scripting for automate builds, parse logs, manage CI pipelines.

- Skilled in coverage-driven verification and confident debugging across RTL, testbench, and workload scenarios.

- Motivated by AI hardware and eager to learn verification strategies for new architectures and domains.

What We Need 

- Contribute to verification of Tensix IP and subsystems from early planning through tape-out, owning coverage goals and driving them to closure.

- Build and maintain reusable verification environments, agents, scoreboards, and supporting infrastructure in SystemVerilog and Python.

- Develop constrained-random and directed tests and close functional, code, and assertion coverage using data-driven approaches.

- Debug complex issues across RTL and testbench while collaborating with design, firmware, compiler, and architecture teams.

- Help evolve DV infrastructure including regression flows, CI/CD integration, EDA compute environments, and reproducible setups.

- Nice to have: Exposure to functional safety (FuSa) verification concepts for automotive AI workloads.

- Nice to have: Familiarity with formal verification methodologies, SVA (SystemVerilog Assertions), or formal property verification for complex control logic and microarchitectural corner cases.

What You Will Learn 

- How Tenstorrent verifies AI-native compute architectures including Tensix cores, RISC-V CPUs, matrix units, vector units, and datapath.

- How simulation, emulation, and software-driven workloads combine to validate both functional correctness and performance.

- How numerical precision formats such as BF16, FP4, and INT8 and on-chip dataflow impact verification complexity and coverage strategy.

- How to build scalable DV infrastructure across hybrid compute environments including containerized regression systems.

- How data analytics and modern AI tooling can enhance verification workflows and accelerate convergence.

Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made. 

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer. 

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology. Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2). These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

- 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

-

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

-

-

Requirements

5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems.

- 
Strong backend engineering experience, including designing APIs, working with databases, and building scalable services.

- 
Proficiency in Python and experience with modern backend frameworks.

- 
Experience building and maintaining distributed systems and cloud-based applications.

Comfortable owning systems end to end, from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

Experience working across different parts of the stack, with the ability to build internal tools or frontend interfaces when needed.

Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and make pragmatic engineering decisions.

- 
Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and non-technical stakeholders across different functions.

Bonus

Experience deploying and integrating ML models into production applications.

Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI & Science Platform
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. Itâs built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internetâs largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Reddit has a flexible workforce! If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like. Don't live near one of our offices? No worries: You can apply to work remotely in any country in which we have a physical presence

Reddit brings people together around their interests, questions, and experiences. Our communities create rich and complex data, and we build tools that help people turn that data into reliable understanding.

The Data Science Platform team develops Rosso, Redditâs analytics agent, and the shared tools that support analytical and scientific work across the company. We are looking for software engineers who enjoy building AI systems that people can depend on: useful workflows, clear interfaces, thoughtful evals, and software that improves through production experience.

In this role, you will own a substantial part of our agent and scientific-tooling platform. You will design and ship capabilities, maintain and improve existing systems, and work with applied scientists and data scientists to make advanced analysis accessible. You will remain close to the code and to the people using it, from an initial prototype through rollout, operation, and ongoing refinement.

Responsibilities

- Build, maintain, and improve the software that powers our analytics agent and shared analytical workflows, including backend services, reusable libraries, APIs, and integrations with data and scientific tools.

- Design reliable agent workflows: context retrieval, planning and orchestration, structured tool calls, execution state, result validation, and clear handling of incomplete or failed tasks.

- Develop evaluation infrastructure and use it continuously. Maintain versioned task sets, automated checks, human-reviewed examples, regression reports, and release gates that expose meaningful failures.

- Improve agent quality through careful failure analysis and measured changes to prompts, context, tools, model selection, and workflow design, balancing correctness, latency, and cost.

- Operate production systems with actionable observability, incident response, dependency upgrades, backward-compatible interfaces, staged releases, and rollback paths.

- Build secure analytical execution and data integrations with appropriate access controls, execution limits, audit trails, provenance, and reproducible artifacts.

- Partner with scientists to turn validated methods into supported capabilities, preserving input requirements, diagnostics, uncertainty, and limitations through the API and agent experience.

- Lead technical design and delivery within your area, coordinate with partner teams, review code and designs, mentor engineers, and improve how the team builds and maintains software.

- Work directly with users to prioritize recurring needs, support adoption and migrations, and measure whether the platform helps people complete analytical work successfully.

Required qualifications

- Substantial professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production services, platforms, or developer tools from design through deployment and ongoing operation. Five or more years is a useful sourcing guideline.

- Strong programming ability, including production Python, and sound engineering fundamentals in API design, data modeling, automated testing, code review, distributed systems, and debugging.

- Hands-on experience building and deploying tool-using agents or multi-step LLM applications, with concrete understanding of context, structured outputs, orchestration, state, and model failure modes.

- Experience designing and using evals to improve AI systems: representative cases, baselines, failure analysis, grader limitations, and quality criteria that influence what ships.

- Practical experience with service reliability, authorization, queues or asynchronous execution, timeouts, retries, idempotency, and operational monitoring.

- Working fluency in SQL and experience integrating data-intensive services or analytical tools; an ability to preserve data provenance and documented analytical constraints.

- A record of leading substantial technical work with other engineers and partner teams, explaining tradeoffs clearly, and helping others contribute effectively.

- A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with analytics agents, text-to-SQL, data discovery, notebook or code-execution environments, or internal platforms for data scientists.

- Experience with agent evaluation harnesses, tool protocols such as MCP, model gateways, retrieval systems, or secure sandboxed execution.

- Experience building reusable scientific libraries, packaging statistical methods behind stable APIs, or collaborating closely with scientists on validation.

- Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and large-scale analytical data systems such as BigQuery, Trino, Spark, or Airflow.

- Experience building product interfaces in TypeScript or React, or improving developer experience and adoption for a shared platform.

This is a hands-on software engineering role. We value the ability to learn the analytical domain and work well with scientific experts; a research degree, publication record, and novel-method research are not required.

Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds. We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home. 

Join our team as a

Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead!

This is a hybrid role, and we are currently considering candidates based in the Netherlands. 

Protolabs is a digital manufacturing company that turns CAD files and technical drawings into physical parts fast and at scale. Our AI team builds systems that empower workflows in digital manufacturing such as finding similar parts, geometry understanding, and automated routing of work to the right expert.

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to act as Technical Lead for our horizontal innovation work, the foundational technical building blocks that serve multiple use cases across the value chain.

The work is distinct in that the technology often comes first and the use case follows: this is true innovation, where you prove a capability is possible and then drive it into business value. You will be the single technical point of contact for these initiatives, driving core development of transformative capabilities. You will observe the market, bring new innovations into the organization, and partner across engineering and business teams to turn technology into measurable impact — mentoring and influencing engineers inside and outside your own team without formal authority.

What You Will Do: 
Technical leadership & core development 

- Drive core development of transformative capabilities.

- Create, maintain, and review the technical roadmap together with product and engineering management.

- Provide architectural guidance for ML systems on inference, agentic approaches and hybrid AI systems; industrialize and maintain proven-value use cases.

Technical implementation across a broad range of AI use cases 

- Implement progressive ML solutions for various business domains in agile, crossfunctional teams; rapidly prototype to validate feasibility and value in a scalable manner.

- Co-develop use cases with domain software teams in temporary cross-functional setups.

Market observation & innovation 

- Observe the market and propose new innovations based on technologies emerging outside the company.

- Evaluate build vs. buy vs. adapt decisions based on cost, effort, risk, and long-term maintainability.

- Produce written technology-evaluation recommendations (opportunity, feasibility, effort, fit) and find ways to multiply exploration speed by involving other engineers.

- Identify opportunities where new technology could add business value; hand clear tech ideas to product and business teams to review and validate; identify integration requirements.

Cross-organisation delivery & architecture 

- Partner with other engineering teams to deliver business impact through integrating new technologies and new solutions.

- Draft, share, and align architectural designs for each building block across the organisation, obtaining sign-off from affected teams before integration starts; bring designs to architecture board review.

Platform & environment 

- Contribute to foundational environments for (Gen)AI experimentation, model development, evaluation, and deployment.

- Collaborate with global platform counterparts to implement MLOps, CI/CD, data pipelines, and observability.

- Advocate for reusable components, shared libraries, and internal tooling to accelerate usecase delivery.

Mentoring & influencing 

- Mentor and coach engineers across the organisation — inside and outside your own team— through PR reviews, work scoping, design reviews, and documentation reviews.

- Proactively surface in-team and cross-team barriers to leadership as they arise, with suggestions on how to resolve them.

- Identify needs and tech-stack gaps blocking engineers from delivering, and raise them for prioritization.

What You Bring: 
Technical 

- 7+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with strong depth in machine learning and deep learning — modeling, data pipelines, evaluation, and shipping models to production using state-of-the-art frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, scikit-learn, XGBoost).

- Proven ability to build models that serve as autonomous decision systems — applied to critical business problems with large, heterogeneous data.

- Strong Python engineering fundamentals: clean, modular, testable code; data pipelines; model versioning; CI/CD for ML; packaging for production (e.g. Docker, service wrappers).

- Solid ML experimentation practice: experiment tracking set up from scratch (e.g. Weights & Biases, MLflow), model evaluation, and iterative improvement tied to measurable business outcomes.

- Solid understanding of data transformation techniques, languages, and libraries (e.g. Pandas, Polars, SQL, dbt).

- Familiarity with modern GenAI — LLMs, transformers, vector stores, retrieval techniques (RAG), embedding strategies, and agentic workflows — and GenAI stacks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and OpenAI/Azure/AWS SDKs.

- Cloud-native, building scalable, secure, and compliant production systems.

- MLOps background: CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring/observability, IaC, and workflow orchestration (e.g. Prefect, Weights & Biases, or equivalents).

- Familiarity with backend systems principles, including API serving, containerization, distributed compute, security considerations.

Leadership & Collaboration 

- Demonstrated ability to lead technically without formal authority: mentoring engineers, design/PR/documentation reviews, and aligning stakeholders across teams.

- Experience owning architecture end-to-end: drafting, sharing, and driving sign-off of architectural designs across multiple teams.

- Experience working in Agile environments — contributing to Scrum ceremonies, breaking work into increments, and collaborating closely with product and engineering management in iterative delivery.

- Ability to lead through ambiguity and early-stage environments; proactive, systematic problem solving.

- Ability to translate emerging technology into business value — framing opportunities, scoping with product and engineering partners, and identifying integration requirements.

- Excellent communication skills across global departments: able to align engineers, product/engineering management, and leadership, and to present technical opportunities to both engineering and business audiences.

Mindset 

- Builder mentality: pragmatic, resourceful, iterative.

- Curiosity and willingness to experiment while ensuring quality and security.

- Critical thinking in uncertain or rapidly evolving contexts

Bonus Points If You Have : 

- Experience with AWS managed services. 

- Experience with manufacturing/industrial ML applications. 

- Experience with geometric/spatial data: point clouds, meshes, voxel grids, or CAD - derived representations. 

- Experience with vector databases, scalable retrieval architectures, guard railing LLMs, and prompt engineering. 

- Experience collaborating in international teams across time zones. 

What's In It For You: 

- Part of our incredible journey is clearly down to our amazing team, and we strongly believe in giving people a space to truly, authentically be themselves. We also believe that treating our employees well and sprinkling a great place to work with some nice perks can make work a little sweeter.

- Daily Lunch and snacks are provided in the office; it's a moment for our teams to connect and recharge. Shared meals strengthen our bonds and fuel collaboration.

- Follow us on Instagram to see what Life at Protolabs is all about!

description:
Curveglass is a startup incubated by AE Studio that provides a flight-level correction layer for airline revenue management, helping airlines make better decisions through advanced data science and modeling.
As part of the AE Studio ecosystem, Curveglass combines the speed, focus, and ownership of a startup with access to a broader network of engineering, AI, and product expertise.
Curveglass runs directly inside each airline's cloud environment. Our product consists of a common Core and a client-specific Adapter , which handles everything needed to make Curveglass work within each airline's environment — including the web application, APIs, data integrations, business rules, and exports into the airline's systems.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

As a Technical Account Manager at Curveglass, you'll own the technical implementation of Curveglass for airline clients end-to-end.
This is a hands-on engineering role with broad ownership. You'll build and maintain client-specific Adapter code, work across frontend and backend systems, integrate with airline data and infrastructure, and deploy and operate Curveglass within client cloud environments.
You'll also work directly with clients. That means understanding their technical and business needs, participating in and leading meetings, troubleshooting issues, analyzing recommendation results in collaboration with revenue management teams, and managing technical expectations as needed.
You'll work closely with the Curveglass core team to determine what should be solved within a client's Adapter and what should become part of the shared Core. You'll bring client needs back to the team as roadmap input and Core change requests, while owning the implementation of client-specific functionality yourself.
We're looking for someone who enjoys the full lifecycle of software engineering: understanding the problem, building the solution, deploying it, and seeing how it performs in the real world.
You'll have meaningful ownership over the systems you build and the opportunity to influence Curveglass's architecture and product as we grow.
If you enjoy owning technical problems end-to-end and working closely with the people using what you build, we'd love to talk.

ABOUT YOU 

You're a strong, pragmatic engineer who enjoys owning systems beyond just writing the code.
You're comfortable working across different parts of the stack and taking responsibility for an implementation from beginning to end: understanding requirements, designing the solution, building integrations and product functionality, deploying infrastructure, troubleshooting issues, and continuing to improve the system once it's live.
You're comfortable operating in a startup environment where problems may not always come neatly defined. You can take ownership, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and move from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production solution.
You also communicate well with people outside of engineering. You can understand the business context behind a technical request, explain technical decisions clearly, and lead conversations with clients when needed.
You work well independently, collaborate closely with data science and product teams, and care about building software that is reliable, maintainable, and genuinely useful.

Required Skills and Experience 

- Strong software engineering experience: You can independently design, build, debug, and maintain production systems.

- Fluency in Python: You're highly proficient with Python and comfortable using it in production environments.

- Full-stack development: You're comfortable working with TypeScript and React and can own frontend functionality when needed.

- SQL and data integration: You can work confidently with relational data, APIs, client datasets, and production data flows.

- Cloud infrastructure: You're comfortable deploying and maintaining applications in AWS or Azure.

- Containers and infrastructure as code: You have hands-on experience with containers and tools such as Terraform.

- End-to-end ownership: You're comfortable taking responsibility for a system across application code, integrations, infrastructure, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

- Client-facing communication: You're comfortable interacting directly with clients, leading technical meetings when needed, explaining decisions clearly, managing expectations, and pushing back thoughtfully when appropriate.

- Business thinking: You care about why something is being built and the outcome it needs to create, not just the technical implementation.

- Production-minded development: You write maintainable code and care about reliability, observability, debugging, and how systems behave in real-world environments.

- AI-powered development: You use modern AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow and know how to use them effectively without sacrificing quality.

- Self-management: You can take ownership of complex problems, navigate ambiguity, and deliver without constant oversight.

- Effective communication in English: You're fluent in spoken and written English and can confidently communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Timezone flexibility: You're comfortable occasionally adapting meeting hours to work with clients across the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East.

Bonus Points for 

- Enterprise implementation experience: You've implemented enterprise or data products where customers require meaningful integration and customization rather than a purely self-service SaaS product.

- Airline or revenue management experience: Familiarity with airline pricing, forecasting, revenue management, or related systems.

- Data engineering experience: You've worked with production data pipelines and technologies such as Parquet, Snowflake, or similar data infrastructure.

- Spanish or Portuguese: Professional proficiency in either language.

- Startup experience: You thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy ambiguity, and are comfortable taking ownership beyond a narrowly defined job description.

- Cloud deployment experience: You've deployed and operated applications or infrastructure within enterprise AWS or Azure environments.

- Strong product instincts: You understand when something should be solved as client-specific functionality versus becoming part of a broader product.

WHAT WE OFFER 

- Startup environment, backed by AE Studio: Join a focused, fast-moving startup while benefiting from the broader engineering, AI, and product ecosystem of AE Studio.

- High-impact engineering: Build production systems that directly shape the Curveglass product and how airlines use it.

- Small, collaborative team: Work closely with engineering, data science, product, and leadership, with significant autonomy over how you solve problems.

- Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere, or connect with the broader AE Studio team and community.

- Flexible schedules: We care about outcomes, ownership, and impact—not micromanagement.

- Competitive compensation: Competitive pay and the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

- Opportunities for growth: Help shape how Curveglass approaches engineering, infrastructure, integrations, and technical decision-making as we scale.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Self-Host Orchestration
description:
Headquarters: Remote, U.S.

URL: https://bitwarden.com 

Bitwarden empowers enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely store and share sensitive data. With a transparent, open-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts. 

As a Software Engineer on the Self-host Orchestration team at Bitwarden, you will directly contribute to projects that our customers use to deploy Bitwarden into their infrastructure. You’ll be a part of the team that builds and maintains the packaging, testing, and deployment for our self-host product , including our Helm chart project . This role also offers the opportunity to interact directly with our open source community through pull request and triaging community issues. This is an all remote team and we are looking for a US based engineer. We don not offer sponsorship at this time

RESPONSIBILITIES 

- 
Be the expert and authority on our Self-host Helm charts and our wider self-host architecture including: backend infrastructure, APIs, database, web app, and how the mobile apps, browser extensions, desktop apps, interact with self-host

- 
Build and maintain our Self-host Helm charts and self-host infrastructure, delivery pipeline, automation, SDLC and development practices.

- 
Collaborate with the rest of the team on system design for our owned tools and codebase.

- 
Collaborate closely with our Implementation Engineering and Customer Success teams to understand client needs and implement technical solutions to address them

- 
Build and maintain tools that deploy & test our self-host stacks on diverse infrastructure setups

- 
Participate in hands-on development of Bitwarden products

- 
Use, maintain, and augment or AI skills and infrastructure as part of our AI-driven product delivery lifecycle.

- 
Participate in code reviews, learning and spreading technical knowledge

- 
Contribute bug fixes for issues submitted by the user community

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN 

- 
High proficiency with containerization and container orchestrators, such as Kubernetes with experience with at least one cloud hosted Kubernetes service (EKS, AKS, GKE)

- 
Proficiency creating and maintaining Helm charts

- 
Experience with Argo CD, Fluxcd, or alternative GitOps delivery tools

- 
Proficiency with at least one cloud platform, Azure preferred 

- 
Proficiency with Git and dependency management 

- 
Experience writing code in at least one programming language, .NET or Python preferred

- 
Proficiency with Linux server administration including Nginx and Bash and/or PowerShell scripting

- 
Excellent communication skills, collaborative mindset, and a zeal for learning — your first phase will be learning everything you can from other team members and documentation

NICE-TO-HAVES 

- 
User of Bitwarden

- 
Startup experience

- 
Open source experience

- 
Remote work experience within an Agile sprint-based project management workflow 

- 
Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions

- 
Experience self-hosting; extra points for experience self-hosting Bitwarden and/or self-hosting on Windows

- 
Experience with Ansible, Terraform, Packer, etc.

- 
Experience with Kubernetes security

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS 

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule a 30-minute screening call and then progress through the following stages: 

- 
Interview with Hiring Manager

- 
A take-home test where you can show off your skills

- 
Interview with the Team

- 
Additional Interviews as required

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US 

- 
Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.

- 
Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.

- 
We are dedicated to building an incredible team. Work remotely with motivated and innovative team members and take part in productive and fun meetups.

- 
Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team.

We recognize and understand that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications for the position, you should still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. Please let us know if you require accommodations during the interview process.

In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $140,000 - $150,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-senior-software-engineer-self-host-orchestration

title: Staff Software Engineer, Ecosystem
description:
Headquarters: United States

URL: https://joinblvd.com 

Who is Boulevard? 

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . 

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most .

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard. 

Boulevard customers are passionate about what they do. Their needs are nuanced and critical, and they rely on us to stand alongside them so they can focus on what they do best. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Ecosystem team, you’ll set the technical direction for Boulevard’s external developer platform and its app and integrations ecosystem, then work across teams to make it real.

This is a green field opportunity. You’ll shape the API platform, the partner experience, and the foundations partners and customers depend on, including API security, identity and access, audit trails, and eventing infrastructure. It’s an individual contributor role with wide influence: you won’t manage people, you’ll lead through technical judgment, clear communication, and trust, working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Design, Partnerships, and Product Marketing. We’re small enough that your work is visible every day.

What you’ll do here: 

- Set the technical strategy for Boulevard’s API and app ecosystem, making sure it supports company goals and partner needs.

- Work across engineering teams to align on direction and drive the right implementation, without formal authority over those teams.

- Lead platform-level changes that cross team boundaries: gain agreement, plan the rollout, and see the work through.

- Find the gaps between what the platform provides and what business priorities require, and turn them into clear, scoped, prioritized proposals.

- Learn what partners and integrators need and bring those needs into the platform roadmap.

- Write and review design documents and architecture decisions, explaining trade-offs and risks to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Write code and ship high-impact work, setting the standard for quality, observability, and security.

- Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and coaching, and remove blockers so teammates can do their best work.

- Define and monitor system health metrics for the API platform, address technical debt before it affects reliability or performance, and help guide incidents from response to resolution and improvement.

What you’ll need to thrive: 

- Experience as a Staff-level or senior engineer who has led large, cross-team technical initiatives.

- Experience building and scaling external-facing API products. GraphQL experience is strongly preferred.

- Experience building and maintaining integrations with third-party APIs.

- Experience designing and operating systems at scale, including enterprise-grade systems.

- Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, Go, or Elixir. Elixir experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

- Influence without authority and sound technical judgment: you gain alignment through clear reasoning and trust, and you anticipate scale, maintenance, and operational cost.

- Business and partner awareness, and clear communication: you connect technical decisions to business priorities and partner needs, and adapt your message to your audience.

- A mentor’s mindset, ownership, and forward thinking: you help other engineers grow, move work forward when the path is unclear, state risks openly, and set long-term direction while delivering value in the short term.

- A plus: experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

How we’ll take care of you: 

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we're happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $193,900 - 225,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

- Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.

- Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.

- Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.

- An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.

- 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.

- 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.

- Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free. 

- Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success. 

- $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.

- And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

To learn how Boulevard collects, uses, and protects personal information related to candidates and employees, please review our Boulevard Employee & Personnel Privacy Notice .

Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. 

Outside Employment Disclosure 
Boulevard serves the beauty, wellness, and self-care industry, and many of our employees have access to our customers' business and client data. Because of that, we ask all candidates to disclose any concurrent employment, self-employment, ownership interest, or advisory role during the hiring process, including the company name and industry. Disclosure is a normal part of our process and is not by itself a barrier to being hired. Employees in Tier 1 Restricted Roles may not hold concurrent employment, ownership, or an advisory role with a beauty, wellness, self-care, or med-spa business, or with a company that competes with Boulevard. If you currently hold such a role, you are still welcome to apply — please raise it early with your recruiter so we can talk it through. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/boulevard-staff-software-engineer-ecosystem

https://cardog.app/careers We're the system of record for the Canadian vehicle: raw automotive data turned into facts that can be checked. Our open-source VIN decoder sits underneath a government vehicle registry. Some of what's interesting: - A government registry, a manufacturer's own filing, a listing site and an insurance record will describe the same truck four different ways, and nothing in any of those files says they're the same truck. Reconciling that, for every vehicle in the country, in a way that holds up when a regulator asks how you know, is most of the data work. - Seventeen characters on a door frame encode manufacturer, plant, model year and build attributes — badly, inconsistently, and differently per manufacturer. Public reference data covers some of it. The rest gets worked out from filings, recall documents, and patterns inferred across millions of vehicles. - We read vehicles directly over OBD-II now. Forty modules answered on a recent Hyundai, each reporting its own part number and installed software version. Nothing downstream of the VIN moves when a module is reflashed, so no registration, history report or dealer system knows what software is actually in a car. - Deliver high throughput and low latency across large, distributed platforms.
- Partner with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines that automate testing, deployment, and monitoring.
- Design AI powered automation frameworks for faster development cycles and automated regression testing.
- Decide where AI adds value in the codebase and where human design must lead. Set review standards for AI assisted code.
- Monitor, diagnose, and resolve performance issues with observability tools and logs.
- Follow and enforce secure coding practices. Take part in security audits and reviews.
- Lead code reviews, mentor junior developers, and contribute to architecture decisions.
- Track industry trends and improve system performance, resilience, and developer productivity.

Required

- 5+ years of hands on Java development with deep knowledge of object oriented design and the Spring Framework, including Spring Boot and Spring Cloud.
- 3+ years designing and building cloud native applications on AWS, including S3, Valkey, Lambda, RDS, and EKS or ECS.
- 3+ years with distributed messaging systems such as Apache Kafka, with a solid grasp of event streaming.
- Proven record building and integrating large scale, high performance, distributed systems with fault tolerance, scalability, and low latency.
- AI first mindset, with daily hands on use of AI tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot for coding, testing, debugging, and documentation.
- Clear judgment on when and where AI improves engineering outcomes, and a record of keeping AI generated code from lowering quality, performance, or design.
- Proficiency building and consuming RESTful APIs with JSON and XML.
- Strong experience with relational or NoSQL databases, including schema design, performance tuning, and query optimization.
- Hands on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitLab CI and Jenkins.
- Solid knowledge of application and data security, including authentication, authorization, and data protection.
- Self motivated. You work well on your own in a fast paced, agile environment.
- Fast learner who adapts to new technologies, teams, and environments.
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a proactive, solution oriented approach.

Preferred

The Company 

Everfield is a platform with a mission in acquiring, building, and operating vertical market and specialist software companies, focused on European businesses. As a Senior Data Engineer at Everfield, you will leverage your expertise and experience to:

- Continuously improve scalability and stability of our data platform called the Lakehouse 

- Create new data pipeline solutions on various data sources (ERP, CRMs, etc.)

- Design and model data in a common data model and Kimball-style dimensional models, making it ready for consumption in Power BI and other tools

- Further developing Lakehouse Lumen , our MCP server that makes Lakehouse data available to Claude for end users

- Improve existing solutions to improve value add for various stakeholders

You’ll be working as part of the Business Intelligence (BI) team. Currently the team consists of a Lead Data Engineer, three Data Analysts and a hands-on team lead. The BI team creates value for various stakeholders (CEO, Finance, COO, Sales, Marketing, and Everfield’sportfolio companies), by creating insights, delivering analysis, automating reporting processes and improving data quality.

The team builds pipelines with Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics to ingest the data into our data platform, uses Azure Databricks for data transformation, Power BI for data visualization and Azure Container Apps to expose data via a MCP server to Claude. For most solutions, the team uses Python and SQL .

For many use cases we work in an agentic way, using Claude to plan and implement them. To support this, we built the "Lakehouse DevKit". A set of agents and skills that we plan to keep extending and improving.

This role is hybrid from Amsterdam area.

Responsibilities 

Adhere to the DevOps methodology by:

- Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer and Team Lead to plan and prioritize tasks.

- Develop data pipelines in Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics, along with data ingestion and process scripts using PySpark and Pandas, while managing version control through Git.

- Improve and extend the MCP server that provides data to Claude.

- Create unit tests, test your own work and review work of colleagues (via Pull Requests), to ensure quality control.

- Extend the Lakehouse DevKit to support and accelerate agentic development workflows.

- Enhance and maintain deployment pipelines to facilitate smooth releases to end users.

- Monitor the data platform (including data pipelines, ingestion/processing jobs, and alerts), while continuously improving logging and monitoring practices.

Ideal Candidate Profile 

Hard Skills 

Required:

- 3+ year of experience as Data Engineer , and 5+ years of professional experience within Data or related fields.

- Expert in PySpark and Pandas for data processing.

- Experience with Databricks for advanced analytics.

- Strong knowledge of SQL and data modeling (especially star schema).

- Familiarity with financial systems (ERP, NetSuite, SAP) and/or experience with CRM systems and customer data .

Nice to have:

- Experience with Claude Code (agents, skills)

- Knowledge of Power Query and Power BI for data visualization.

- Experience deploying Azure resources like Azure Container Apps .

Soft Skills 

- Independent Worker : Ability to operate autonomously while contributing effectively to team goals.

- Business Acumen : Strong understanding of business and economic principles, with an ability to apply them in a data context.

- Analytical Mindset : Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

- Collaborative : Actively seeks alignment with team members and participates in planning sessions.

- Quality-Focused : Committed to reviewing both your own work and that of others to maintain high standards.

- Strategic Planner : Consider alternative solutions and refine features before implementation.

- Purpose-Driven : Demonstrates a deep understanding of tasks, ensuring they align with business objectives.

- Enable growth by building a robust and scalable data platform.

- Working with the latest Data Engineering & Data Modeling technologies.

- Long term career opportunities.

- Working from home for up to 4 days per week.
